screen: Machine rail 'Next action' card (persistent, all views)
evidence: While the plotter is offline (red banner: 'Plotter offline â check power and WiFi, then press CONNECT on SETUP'), the Next action card still instructs 'Jog to the paper origin, then SET WORK ZERO below.' and its blockers line reads 'blockers: work zero · print paused' â the connection, the one blocker that makes jogging impossible, is missing. The operator gets two conflicting next-step instructions, and the dedicated guidance card gives the wrong one. Identical copy on all 12 view dumps in dump.json.
measurement: Blockers line = 'work zero · print paused'; banner remedy = 'press CONNECT on SETUP'; 0 of 12 views list connection as a blocker
recommendation: Make 'plotter offline' the first-ranked blocker and switch the Next action copy to 'Connect the plotter (SETUP → MACHINE → CONNECT)' whenever FluidNC is unreachable; only advance to jog/work-zero guidance once connected.

evidence: The 'Plotter offline' notification is pinned bottom-center on every view (DISMISS button at (846,746) in all 12 dumps) and physically overlaps interactive content: on CREATE views it covers the right half of the REFRESH PREVIEW button (button x=238-378, banner starts ~x=340), and on PRINT it covers the sheet filename, progress bar, and the 'Uploaded SVG finished' status line.
measurement: Banner occludes ~38px of the 140px REFRESH PREVIEW button and the entire PRINT status strip
recommendation: Move the persistent offline state into a reserved slot (e.g. the top-bar chip area or a docked strip that reflows content) instead of a floating toast that occludes controls; keep the toast only for the moment of transition.

screen: Machine rail 'Manual motion' card (persistent, all views)
evidence: The card's only caption is the static text 'Blocked while G-code streams.' shown even when nothing is streaming and the plotter is disconnected â it states a reason for unavailability that is not the current one. The jog/PEN/HOME buttons render as enabled while offline, and the only truthful status is a bare 12px 'Not ready' under SET WORK ZERO with no cause.
measurement: Caption identical across all 12 view dumps regardless of state; 'Not ready' fs=12px
recommendation: Make the caption state-driven ('Offline â connect on SETUP first' / 'Blocked: G-code streaming' / 'Ready') and visually disable jog controls when they cannot act; expand 'Not ready' to name its cause.

evidence: The Pen lifts slider's value bubble shows the raw code expression "value >= 1024 ? 'off' : value" instead of the evaluated value â a leaked label template. screen: Top bar chip + PRINT view (paused-state vocabulary)
evidence: The same state is named three ways with no visible mapping to the control that clears it: top-bar chip says 'OPERATOR PAUSED', the blockers line says 'print paused', and the available controls are 'START SYSTEM' / 'NEW RUN' (PRINT rail) and 'RESUME' (SETUP/MACHINE, scoped 'alarm or hold only'). Nothing on screen says which action un-pauses; the Next action card never mentions it.
measurement: 3 terms (OPERATOR PAUSED / print paused / START SYSTEM-RESUME) for one state; 0 controls labeled with the chip's wording
recommendation: Pick one term (e.g. 'Paused') for chip, blockers, and the resuming control, and make the chip itself clickable or captioned with the clearing action ('Paused â press START SYSTEM').

evidence: With no image folder chosen, the sheet preview status renders as a bare hyphen ('-', 3px-wide text element at (945,430)) â no explanation or next step. evidence: The success toast confirms generation (good) but its content is a raw temp filesystem path: 'G-code file: /var/folders/m0/.../spool/gui_sheet_20260815_230416.gcode', with no operator-meaningful next step even though the intended follow-up (START TEST PRINT) is on the same card.

evidence: The queue stat 'FAIL/SKIP 0 / 177' merges two different outcomes into one tile and surfaces 177 skips with no explanation, breakdown, or drill-down; a fresh operator cannot tell whether 177 skipped jobs is normal or a problem. The adjacent 'Queue counts loaded' caption confirms data freshness but not meaning.

evidence: The screen the offline banner sends operators to ('press CONNECT on SETUP') reports status in engineer vocabulary: 'WEBUI offline', 'TELNET offline', 'INPUTS none', 'MODAL -'. The banner speaks operator language ('check power and WiFi') but the destination page does not, so the operator cannot confirm what improved after pressing CONNECT.
recommendation: Lead with one operator-level status line ('Plotter: not reachable â check power and WiFi') and keep the protocol pills as secondary detail or inside Diagnostics.

evidence: Every parameter iteration in the creative loop requires an explicit REFRESH PREVIEW press (the text-preview flow needed it as a dedicated step); previews do not update on parameter change, adding one detour step per tweak in the app's highest-frequency loop â while SETUP/ADVANCED states 'Display filters affect preview immediately', an inconsistent update model.
measurement: text-preview flow: 3 steps, 7.6s, of which 1 step is the manual refresh
recommendation: Debounce-auto-refresh previews on parameter change (keep the button as a manual fallback for heavy renders), or at least mark the preview stale ('settings changed â refresh') so the operator knows the shown preview no longer matches the inputs.
